Name: (CP) Matcha Recipes
Author: suushiico
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.

Expands the recipe book with 10 brand new recipes for tea leaves.[/center]

[b][size=6]Installation
[/size][/b]
You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download the .zip file under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder.


[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Where can I get the recipes?
[/b][/size]You can purchase every recipe from the Stardrop Saloon.

[size=4][b]What are the 10 new recipes?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Matcha Latte[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Ice Cream[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Ginger Smoothie[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Mochi[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Cookies[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Waffles[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Swiss Roll[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Sticky Rice[/size]
[*][size=2]Matcha Moon Cake[/size]
[*][size=2]Strawberry Matcha Crepes[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Is this mod balanced?[/b][/size]
[size=2]Nope, not really! The items offer decent profit in order to encourage modders to cook the items. As well, each item offers the green tea boost (+30 max energy and +1 speed for 4 minutes and 12 seconds) since each recipe incorporates tea leaves. Also, I made each of the 10 new dishes a Loved gift for both Caroline and Lewis since Green Tea is a Loved gift already :)
